configJson.description:
JSON file(s) with application configuration.
Parameters values from json file are overwritten by values provided at command line.
Type: vector<string>

configDumpJson.description:
Name of the JSON file used for configuration dump
Type: string

controllerConfigPath.description:
Path of the JSON file with runController configuration.
Type: string

dataFile.description:
Comma separated list of input files.
Type: string

treeName.description:
Name of a TTree containing event data, read by EventSourceROOT.
Type: string

readNEvents.description:
Number of events to read from input file; -1 means all events.
Type: int

gainMapFile.description:
Relative gain map g(X_DET) of the readout plane (lines: x_lo x_hi gain, mm). Hit charges are divided by g(X_DET) at the hit position after the 3D fit (charge profile for the dE/dx fit, integrated charge). Empty: no correction. Ignored for MC input.
Type: string

resourcesPath.description:
Global path to the resources directory.
Type: string

frameLoadRange.description:
Number of GRAW frames searched for ASAD fragments for given event. Only relevant when storing multiple ASAD boards per GRAW file. Keep it low in online GUI mode.
Type: int

singleAsadGrawFile.description:
Switch defining whether there is a single GRAW input file per ASAD board.
Type: bool

fromGenerator.description:
Switch defining whether input data are from Monte Carlo event generator (true) or from real detector (false).
Type: bool

fileName.description:
Name of the ROOT file name with event data. If the name does NOT contain .root suffix, the output file name will be created from fileName taken as prefix, and the input file name.
Type: string

disabledBranches.description:
Optional list of disabled branches of PEventTPC to save disk space.
Biggest branches are TPCData.myChargeMap*, TPCData.myChargeArray*.
Names are patterns of the TTree::SetBranchStatus: use * to match sub-branches.
Type: vector<string>

recoTree.description:
makeTrackTree: also write the reconstructed Track3D and EventInfo of each stored event to the tree TPCRecoData (branches RecoEvent, EventInfo) in the output file, for recoEventsAnalysis, rawTrackDiffusionAnalysis and other programs that read it.
Type: bool

autoSaveFrequency.description:
Frequency (positive number - events, negative - bytes, 0 - disabled) of TTree auto-save in the output ROOT file.
Type: int

mlTree.description:
Switch for writing the flat MLData tree (plain numeric branches for uproot / TFRecord conversion) next to the TPCData tree.
Type: bool

mlHitFilter.description:
Hit filter for the hits written to the MLData tree: none, threshold or fraction. The threshold and fraction filters use the hitFilter.* parameters.
Type: string

updateInterval.description:
GUI update interval in online mode. Units are [milliseconds].
Type: int

zLogScale.description:
Z axis mode for 2D charge display.
Type: bool

autoZoom.description:
Switch for automatic zoom in on charge deposit in 2D charge display.
Type: bool

recoMode.description:
Switch for enabling manual track reconstruction in GUI mode.
 Reconstructed tracks are saved into a file.
Type: bool

rate.description:
Switch for enabling in online GUI mode rate vs time plot instead of charge projected onto time axis plot.
Type: bool

develMode.description:
Switch for enabling developer set of histograms in GUI / makeTrackTree reconstruction mode.
Type: bool

technicalMode.description:
Switch for enabling detector-specific technical set of histograms in GUI mode.
Type: bool

remove.description:
Switch controlling pedestal removal.
Type: bool

minPedestalCell.description:
Pedestal time cell range - minimal value.
Type: int

maxPedestalCell.description:
Pedestal time cell range - maximal value.
Type: int

minSignalCell.description:
Signal time cell range - minimal value.
Type: int

maxSignalCell.description:
Signal time cell range - maximal value.
Type: int

recoClusterEnable.description:
Switch for enabling hit clustering in 2D charge maps in GUI / makeTrackTree reconstruction mode.
Type: bool

recoClusterThreshold.description:
Charge threshold above pedestal for reco 2D cluster seed hits.
Type: float

recoClusterConstantFractionThreshold.description:
Charge threshold above pedestal as fraction of maximal signal for reco 2D cluster seed hits.
Type: float

recoClusterDeltaStrips.description:
Strip range of hits added to cluster around seed hits passing threshold value.
Type: int

recoClusterDeltaTimeCells.description:
Time bin range of hits added to cluster around seed hits passing threshold value.
Type: int

enabled.description:
Flag enabling event filtering before reconstruction.
Type: bool

maxChargeUpperBound.description:
Upper peak charge threshold to accept an event [ADC units].
Type: float

maxChargeLowerBound.description:
Lower peak charge threshold to accept an event [ADC units].
Type: float

totalChargeLowerBound.description:
Lower threshold on total charge sum to accept an event [ADC units].
Type: float

totalChargeUpperBound.description:
Upper threshold on total charge sum to accept an event [ADC units].
Type: float

events.description:
List of event IDs to be accepted from the input file(s). Empty vector has no effect (default).
Type: vector<unsigned int>

recoProngs.description:
List of allowhttps://pdg.lbl.gov/2025/reviews/rpp2024-rev-passage-particles-matter.pdfed number of reconstructed prongs (tracks) to accept an event. Empty vector has no effect (default).
Type: vector<unsigned int>

pressure.description:
Gas pressure in chamber [mbar]=[hPa].
Type: float

temperature.description:
Gas temperature in chamber [K].
Type: float

driftV.description:
Drift velocity [cm/us]. NOT USED: the drift velocity is read from the geometry file (DRIFT VELOCITY line); this value is kept for documentation of the configuration only.
Type: float

comment.description:
Optional description of TPC working conditions, such as: E-field, HVs.
Type: string

energy.description:
LAB gamma beam energy [MeV].
Type: float

input.description:
Input ROOT file with TPCRecoData tree for recoEventsDiff analysis.
Type: string

reference.description:
Reference ROOT file with TPCRecoData tree for recoEventsDiff analysis.
Type: string

no-type.description:
Flag to skip comparing event type in TPCRecoData trees used for recoEventsDiff analysis.
Type: bool

no-segments.description:
Flag to skip comparing number of segments in TPCRecoData trees used for recoEventsDiff analysis.
Type: bool

no-presence.description:
Flag to skip printing extra- and missing events in TPCRecoData trees used for recoEventsDiff analysis.
Type: bool

no-info.description:
Flag to skip printing file- and tree info on every line in recoEventsDiff analysis.
Type: bool

noTree.description:
Flag to enable saving a TTree with some track properties.
Type: bool

nominalBoost.description:
Flag to enable nominal beam energy when calculating boost to CMS.
Type: bool

beamOffset.description:
Beam offset [mm] in Y_DET direction at X_DET=0, where beam axis: Y_DET = beam_slope*X_DET + beam_offset.
Type: float

beamSlope.description:
Beam slope (=dY_DET/dX_DET), where beam axis: Y_DET = beam_slope*X_DET + beam_offset.
Type: float

beamDir.description:
Incoming beam direction. Positive values denote beam along +X_DET, negative -X_DET.
Type: int

alphaMinCut.description:
Minimal alpha track length [mm].
Type: float

alphaMaxCut.description:
Maximal alpha track length [mm].
Type: float

carbonMinCut.description:
Minimal carbon track length [mm].
Type: float

carbonMaxCut.description:
Maximal carbon track length [mm].
Type: float

alphaScaleCorr.description:
Multiplicative alpha track length correction.
Type: float

alphaOffsetCorr.description:
Additive alpha track length correction [mm].
Type: float

carbonScaleCorr.description:
Multiplicative carbon track length correction.
Type: float

carbonOffsetCorr.description:
Additive carbon track length correction [mm].
Type: float

cutO16.description:
NOT IMPLEMENTED YET! Ptree to enable special plots, Track3D dumping for events passing 2-prong Oxygen-16 elliptic cut in Ekin_CMS(Alpha) x Ekin_CMS(Carbon) phase space.
Type: ptree

tfModelPath.description:
Path to the TensorFlow model Keras file.
Type: string

gainTableFile.description:
Charge gain per setup (lines: run_first run_last pressure_mbar G_cal G_raw; run ID YYYYMMDDhhmmss). G_cal converts the track charge to MeV (chargeEnergy); G_raw gives R = Q/(G_raw E_dep) used to choose the alpha-C orientation of the dE/dx fit. Measured with the gain map on. Empty or no matching row: no conversion, no R selection.
Type: string

dEdxOrientationByR.description:
After the dE/dx fit, refit the other alpha-C orientation (vertex seeded one carbon range from the current alpha end) and keep the fit with |R-1| smaller, R = Q/(G_raw E_dep). Needs a gain table entry for the run.
Type: bool

dEdxOrientationVertexWindow.description:
Half width [mm] of the vertex window of the refit with the other alpha-C orientation.
Type: double

dEdxFitMaxLossRatio.description:
Stop threshold of the dE/dx fit restarts: the first valid fit with loss/Q^2 below this value is kept (Q: integral of the charge profile normalised to its maximum). Only used with dEdxFitAttempts > 1.
Type: double

dEdxFitAttempts.description:
Number of attempts of the dE/dx (event hypothesis) fit, with different initial step sizes (1-10). The first valid fit with a small loss is kept, otherwise the best one.
Type: int

dEdxPhysicsConstraint.description:
Physics constraint of the two prong (recoil + alpha) dE/dx fit: the fit is done with a free recoil range and with the recoil range from momentum conservation in O16 -> C12 + alpha and in O18 -> C14 + alpha (E_recoil = E_alpha*m_alpha/m_recoil, within +- dEdxCarbonRangeMargin); the best fit is kept (recoil PID CARBON_14 for O18). False: free recoil range only.
Type: bool

dEdxCarbonRangeMargin.description:
Relative margin of the carbon range around the value from the physics constraint (dEdxPhysicsConstraint).
Type: float

inputDim.description:
Input tensor dimensions for the TensorFlow model.
Type: vector<int>

outputDim.description:
Output tensor dimensions for the TensorFlow model.
Type: vector<int>
